findings.title: CTF Flag Extracted via Flask Secret Key Crack + JWT alg=none Bypass + IDOR
findings.description:
Chained vulnerabilities to access the 'flag' user's dashboard:
1. Flask SECRET_KEY is 'your_secret_key' (weak, in wordlist) - cracked with flask-unsign
2. JWT library accepts alg=none (no signature verification) - forged JWT bypasses auth
3. IDOR: discovered flag user (user_id=10019) via username enumeration on /password/<username>
4. Forged Flask session with user_id=10019 (flag user) using cracked Flask secret
5. Combined forged Flask session + alg=none JWT with username=flag, user_id=10019 to access flag user dashboard

Login flow: POST / {username} -> /password/<username> -> /dashboard. Username 'flag' exists with user_id=10019.
